requirements_summary: Workloads: chat (customer-facing assistant), embeddings (semantic search), reranking for recommendations.
Latency targets: p95 chat < 350ms (preferred <250ms) for 512-token window; reranking end-to-end < 150ms per request.
Throughput targets: steady-state 80-120 requests/sec during business hours; batch indexing 5000 embedding requests/sec for short windows.
Cost sensitivity: moderate-high. Wants predictable unit cost for committed capacity and transparent per-token breakdown.
Model preferences: open models (Llama-family / Falcon variants), support for 8-bit quantization and CPU fallback for small queries.
Routing/fallback: primary on Dedicated (VPC), fallback to Hosted API model variant in the same region when Dedicated capacity saturated.
Data controls: encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS preferred, audit logs retained 12 months with exportable log formats, deletion/retention controls for user data.
Identity: SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning required, enforce MFA via IdP, SSO test with Okta scheduled.
Network: VPC peering + strict egress rules, proof of isolation for Dedicated GPU pools requested.
Compliance ask: SOC2 Type II report (recent 12 months) and summary of control mapping for logs/retention.
